Every parcel has a destination. Every delivery has a promise.
From bustling metros to the remotest corners of India and across the world, TPC has been delivering with care, speed, and reliability for decades.
Whether it's a business shipment, an important document, or a heartfelt package, we're committed to ensuring it reaches safely, every single time.
📦 Fast. Secure. Reliable.
That's the trust we've delivered for decades.

A proud moment for TPC.
Our Chairman Thomas John, Director Administration Suresh Bharathan, and Manager P. Radhakrishnan had the privilege of meeting the Honorable Chief Minister of Kerala, V.D Satheesan.

Not all shipments are the same, so why should every delivery service be?  
Whether you're sending everyday consignments, time-sensitive packages, or critical high-value shipments, TPC offers a service tailored to your needs.
📦 TPC Standard – Reliable & economical for everyday shipping
⚡ Pro Premium – Faster transit with enhanced visibility and Money Back Guarantee
🚀 Pro EX – Fastest transit, real-time tracking, OTP-secured delivery, and Double Money Back Guarantee
Because no matter what you ship, TPC has the right service for your every need.

A father's concern never takes a day off.
And sometimes, waiting up is his way of saying,
"I'm here."

Before a problem becomes your problem, he's already working on it.
A loose switch.
A broken charger.
A leaking tap.
The little things get fixed before you even notice.
Because that's what dads do. They make life a little easier, without ever asking for credit.

Summoning on-time deliveries like it's our special technique📦✨
Some call it Jutsu. We call it doing what we do best.

Dads don't always express how much they care.
But somehow your favourite snacks are always stocked, the things you need appear before you ask, and whenever life gets difficult, they're quietly there.
No grand speeches. No big gestures.
Just a lifetime of showing up.
Because dads rarely say, "I care."
They deliver it instead.

Some shipments simply can't afford delays.
With PRO PREMIUM, your consignments get priority movement across our network, enhanced tracking visibility, faster delivery commitment, and reliable handling every step of the way. 🚀📦
Because when timing matters, every advantage counts.
Choose PRO PREMIUM at the time of booking.

Across the city or just around the corner, TPC GO's hyperlocal delivery solutions keep your shipments moving with speed and reliability. 📦⚡

From urgent documents to valuable packages and everyday essentials, every shipment is delivered fast, secure, and hassle-free.

Every delivery is an opportunity to make a positive impact. From responsible practices to conscious choices, small steps today help create a healthier planet for future generations.
This World Environment Day, let's commit to reducing our footprint and growing a greener future—one delivery at a time🌱📦

featured_reviews.name: Dharmendar Passi
featured_reviews.review_text:
The company name is The Professional Courier; however, based on our experience, their services do not reflect the professionalism they claim—either in India or internationally.

On February 28, we handed over two parcels at their Vasco, Goa office for dispatch to clients in Canada and the USA. We paid INR 11,000, and a receipt was issued under the company’s name. The parcels were then forwarded to an agent in Mumbai, who was expected to ship them through an international courier partner.

However, the representative at the Vasco office failed to pay the Mumbai agent. As a result, the agent only generated tracking numbers without actually dispatching the parcels. These tracking details were shared with us, and in turn, we shared them with our clients.

Over the next two months, we repeatedly followed up, but the Vasco office representative continued to provide misleading information, often citing external issues such as “war” as the reason for delays. Meanwhile, our clients in the USA and Canada kept raising concerns.

We then escalated the matter to the Panaji head office. A customer service representative spoke with a senior representative , who instructed the Vasco branch to resolve the issue immediately. Unfortunately, no action was taken. We subsequently filed a police complaint. Although the police issued a warning (in person and over the phone), there was still no resolution.

In good faith, we even offered to continue working with them on the condition that the pending parcels be dispatched promptly. However, the representative stopped responding and did not answer calls.

Due to the urgency and our commitment to client satisfaction, we ultimately paid extra amount to the Mumbai agent directly to ensure the parcels were delivered.

Based on this experience, the communication was extremely poor, accountability was lacking, and support from the Goa head office was ineffective. It appears that such issues may not be isolated, and similar complaints may exist from other customers.

We strongly recommend exercising caution when dealing with The Professional Courier. Based on our experience, it is safer to work with reliable international courier companies rather than relying on services that claim professionalism but fail to deliver.
